## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it clearly.
_e.g. "As a student, I find it frustrating that I can't filter study groups by subject..."_

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've already tried or thought about.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or references that would help us understand the request.
